Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about Apex Home Fitness.

whatIs.question: What is Apex Home Fitness?
whatIs.answer: Apex Home Fitness is an AI-powered home fitness app. It builds a personalized workout program from your goals, level, equipment and schedule, then tracks your progress and analytics — no gym required.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: The app is free to use during early access. There are no hidden charges — if pricing changes in the future, we will announce it here first.

equipment.question: Do I need any equipment?
equipment.answer: Most programs are bodyweight only. Some plans may suggest a mat or a resistance band, and your program adapts to the equipment you told us you have.

injury.question: I have an injury or a medical condition. Can I still train?
injury.answer: If you have a medical condition or are recovering from an injury, please check with a doctor before starting. During onboarding you can note your limitations — the app flags high-risk cases and keeps them out of your plan.

offline.question: Can I use the app offline?
offline.answer: Yes. Apex Home Fitness is a progressive web app, so it can be installed on your phone and keeps working with limited or no connection. Offline video downloads are coming soon.

support.question: How do I change my language or contact support?
support.answer: You can switch between English and Persian from Profile → Preferences at any time. For anything else, email us — the address is below.
